# clirec

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/clirec

## Summary

clirec is an alpha Python package for recording mouse and keyboard
demonstrations as human-readable `.clirec` files. Audio is optional and requires
explicit operator opt-in. Format v2 stores referenced media in relative
sidecars and readers validate their SHA-256 hashes.

The source tree is version 0.3.0. The 2026-10-02 GitHub API check found no release or tag; the current PyPI status could not be confirmed in this audit. See RELEASE_GATE.md.

## Audience and target personas

- [PERSONA-01] AI agent and computer-use developers: readable GUI demonstration traces.
- [PERSONA-02] CLI and workflow automation builders: turn interactive operations into commands and parameterized inputs.
- [PERSONA-03] QA and test engineers: versionable event files with optional UI Automation metadata and media hash validation.
- [PERSONA-04] Privacy-conscious teams: parameterized typed-text defaults with review of other captured content before sharing.

## Implementation notes

- The recorder core writes to its configured filesystem path and has no built-in telemetry; caller-provided modules may use network or additional storage.
- Typed keyboard text is parameterized by default; UI metadata, optional frames, and audio still require review.
- `.clirec` event files are plaintext, and replay delegates actions to a caller-provided executor.
- Audio is off by default; flags record operator opt-in, not another person's permission or legal compliance.
- The manifest is published last and readers validate media hashes; recovery removes orphan `.clirec.media` sidecars, not `.clirec.frames` directories.
- The STT adapter passes `persist=False` to the selected module; it cannot enforce module behavior.
- The application uses the permissions of the process that starts it. The core declares no mandatory runtime dependencies.
- Security response times are targets subject to maintainer availability, not guaranteed fix deadlines.

## Related projects

- open-compute (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute) - supplies
  the executor used for replay; exposes oc rec replay.
- open-compute-mcp (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute-mcp) - exposes
  replay as the MCP tool rec_replay.
- ellmos-voice-io (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-voice-io) - STT/TTS
  primitives that can be wrapped as a caller-selected `--module` backend.
- ellmos (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos) - ecosystem hub.

## Boundaries

clirec is not a hosted telemetry service or a full GUI automation platform.
Replay needs a caller-provided executor. Typed keyboard text is parameterized
by default; UI metadata, optional frames, and audio still need review. Audio is
not replayed automatically. The STT adapter imports a caller-selected module
and passes `persist=False`; that module controls its own storage and network
behavior. See SECURITY.md and docs/AUDIO_PRIVACY.md before recording or
sharing sensitive material.
